One of the buggiest, most disappointing full-price games I’ve ever bought. Absolutely nothing has changed for the better since I last played in 2024. If anything, the developers have actively made the game worse just to cash in on a console port.

For a game that markets itself entirely on "tactical realism," there is zero actual realism in sight. They completely ruined the main experience. Updates have done nothing but fucked up performance, muddy the textures, and make awkward, unpolished animations. The scoring system and bs "Rules of Engagement" are complete shit. You’ll get penalized for "unnecessary force" because a suspect faked a surrender, only for them to instant-draw a weapon and kill you from the back with two shots before you can even react, meanwhile your ai team is across the map not following you.

The enemy AI acts like literal aimbots with permanent wallhacks, tracking your head through solid steel and pitch-black darkness before you can even react. Meanwhile, your own swat team is completely brainless. They will literally block doorways, freeze up mid-fight, or just flat-out ignore the room-clearing commands. They are unable to do anything remotely by themselves. I am not trying to babysit an entire swat team bro.

The game is a broken, boring chore that is completely unplayable without community-made mods to fix the developer's lack of braincells. If a game relies entirely on its community to fix the games main issues, it’s just a bad game.

Don't buy it unless you enjoy getting it up the ass. The piece of shit developers took the initial hype money and checked out. Save your money.
